name: P16
title: Pulmonary Rehabilitation Pathway
description: The patient attends a respiratory disease specialist visit. Subsequently, the patient performs the prescribed exercises three times per week while undergoing SpO₂ monitoring. If oxygen saturation falls below the prescribed threshold, the practitioner is alerted.
